title: First human playtest: digital and paper rounds (no game code)
problem: Rules version 4 has never been played by an unfamiliar person. Balance work so far used computer players only. DEC-016 approved a first playtest but it has not been run, and DEC-027 makes the tabletop rules the master, so a paper round is needed as well.
scope: Write hypotheses and continue, revise or stop criteria before testing (DEC-016: at least 3 of 4 testers can explain a lost sale by day 3; provisional, owner-set)
3 to 5 unfamiliar players, no coaching; each plays one digital Quick game against three computer shops (four shops in all) on the preview

Testers play the preview (rules version 4) from a browser link on their own devices. The owner sends the link and a short set of questions; answers and any notes are saved as the session report. No in-person table round, no paper kit, no app change. Hand-played ageing is NOT tested by this plan
One playtest report per session using the playtest template; observations kept separate from interpretation; tester count and build recorded
Owner decision recorded: continue, revise or stop
exclusions: Any change to rules, balance, content, art or code (rules freeze, DEC-026)
Collecting names or personal data (notes only)
Deciding the physical edition, printing or manufacturing

acceptance.text: Hypotheses and criteria are written and dated before the first session
acceptance.evidence: Questions and criteria locked 2026-10-27 20:09 (Asia/Kuala_Lumpur), before any tester was sent the link. Owner: "The draft questions and criteria are fine. Lock them in as of today.". Text recorded in REP-042.

acceptance.text: 3 to 5 remote digital sessions (tester plays one Quick game against three computer shops from the link) each have a saved report with the tester's answers, tester count and build
acceptance.evidence: Ended early by the owner (2026-10-27 22:20). No formal PLAN-019 session was run; the Tally form had no submissions. One informal 4-player game (REP-045) does not match the setup.

acceptance.text: No change to src/, server/ or RULES.md between the first and last session (git diff shows none)
acceptance.evidence: git diff of src, server, RULES.md and package.json between origin/main and the records branch is empty (2026-10-27 22:20). No game file changed.

acceptance.text: Owner decision (continue, revise, stop) recorded with the evidence
acceptance.evidence: Owner ended the plan early: "the ones i entered here is the feedback, just end the testing". No continue, revise or stop reading of the game was made.
